hubspot.com: 55. The gap: text contrast.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

Lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.

Lesson: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.

montesofia.com: 45. The gap: framing.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

Lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

movichhotels.com: 68. The gap: measurement.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

Lesson: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.
